note: Howard County Conservation 10-acre park on the Upper Iowa River at Lime Springs, above the historic Lidtke Mill dam. The gravel pads sit inside a single loop on open lawn, with the river beyond the loop road on the west side. Shelter, playground, boat ramp, and the Upper Iowa canoe access across the road; Lidtke Mill (1857, national historic site) is open weekend afternoons Memorial Day-Labor Day, and Hayden Prairie is nearby. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 (county camping page), water and electric at sites, flush toilets, showers, water, FCFS self-register. Amperage and site count are not posted. Riverview stands; the campground is on the mill pool above the dam, not below it. Phone (563) 547-3634 found (none stored).
flags: WATERFRONT riverview stands. Imagery: the pads are angled spurs inside a single gravel loop on a bend of the Upper Iowa (~90 m wide here incl. shore ice, so a river, not a creek). The loop road runs between the west-side pads and a 10-20 m grass bank, so 20-35 m from water with the campground's own road between (view, not on-water). The campground is on the mill pool upstream of the Lidtke Mill dam (dam at ~43.4645,-92.2788 by the road bridge), so the below-dam rule does not apply. The county photo shows open lawn pads with bare trees between them and the river.
PHONE MISSING: the entry stores no phone. The county's Lidtke page gives 'Phone: (563) 547-3634' (Howard County Conservation Board, Prairie's Edge Nature Center).

HOOKUPS/SITES: no amperage and no site count are posted. The stored electric 50 and count 30 (derived from old note prose) were not confirmed; they were left as they are, and the note no longer repeats them.
